mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT D.route_id AS routeId, D.route_nm AS routeNm, D.route_ver AS routeVer, D.bms_route_dc AS routeDc FROM smartbusmngdb.sbm_facility A JOIN busroutedb.bms_pr_veh_lc B ON A.veh_id = B.veh_id JOIN busroutedb.ms_veh C ON A.veh_id = C.veh_id LEFT JOIN busroutedb.matched_ms_route D ON B.route_id = D.bms_route_id WHERE A.group_id = #{userGroupId} AND D.route_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY D.route_nm, D.bms_route_dc
SELECT sttn_id as sttnId, sttn_nm as sttnNm, sttn_no as sttnNo FROM busroutedb.ms_sttn

select distinct maker_nm as makerNm, model_nm as modelNm from busroutedb.ms_veh
maker_nm IS NOT NULL AND maker_nm <> '' AND model_nm IS NOT NULL AND model_nm <> ''
AND group_id = #{userGroupId}
ORDER BY maker_nm, model_nm
